form.setup: Eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades pulled down and back. Grip a little wider than shoulders.
cues: Lower to mid-chest with control.
Elbows about 45° from your body, not flared to 90°.
Drive your feet into the floor as you press.
watch: Bouncing the bar off your chest.
Hips lifting off the bench.

form.setup: Slide the bench so the bar lines up with your mid-chest. Set the safety stops just below chest height.
cues: Shoulder blades down and back before you unhook.
Lower to mid-chest, elbows about 45° out.
Press straight up; the rails guide the path.
watch: Bench too far forward or back, which puts the bar at your neck or belly.
Letting the bar drop onto your chest.

form.setup: Sit with the dumbbells on your knees, lie back and kick them up one at a time. Feet flat, shoulder blades pinned.
cues: Lower until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Press up and slightly in, dumbbells nearly touching at the top.
Keep wrists stacked over elbows the whole way.
watch: Dumbbells drifting toward your face.
Going so heavy that the first set falls below the rep range.

form.setup: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest. Back flat against the pad, feet planted.
cues: Shoulder blades back against the pad before the first rep.
Press until your arms are nearly straight, without locking hard.
Let the handles come back until you feel a chest stretch.
watch: Seat too low, which turns it into a shoulder press.
Letting the stack slam between reps.

form.setup: Hands a little wider than shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Lower until your chest is a fist above the floor.
Elbows about 45° from your body.
watch: Hips sagging.
Half reps at the top.

form.setup: Bench at about 30°. Feet planted, slight arch, shoulder blades pulled down and back.
cues: Touch the upper chest, just below the collarbones.
Elbows about 45° from your body.
Press up and slightly back over your shoulders.
watch: A bench steeper than 45°, which turns it into a shoulder press.
Bouncing the bar off your chest.

form.setup: Bench at about 30°, positioned so the bar meets your upper chest just below the collarbones. Safety stops a hand's width above your chest.
cues: Shoulder blades down and back, then unhook with a small twist.
Lower under control to the upper chest.
Press straight up and lock the bar back onto the hooks with a twist.
watch: The bar touching your neck or mid-chest: move the bench, not your body.
Elbows flaring out to 90°.

form.setup: Bench at about 30°. Kick the dumbbells up from your knees one at a time.
cues: Lower until the dumbbells are level with your upper chest.
Press up and slightly in.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.
watch: Bench too steep.
Letting the elbows drop below the bench at the bottom.

form.setup: Bar at your collarbones, grip just outside your shoulders, elbows slightly in front of the bar. Squeeze glutes and abs.
cues: Move your head back, press, then push your head through under the bar.
Lock out with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower back to the collarbones under control.
watch: Leaning back into an incline press.
Elbows flaring straight out to the sides.

form.setup: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height. Back flat against the pad.
cues: Press up until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower until the handles are level with your shoulders.
Ribs down: don't arch off the pad.
watch: Seat so low that the handles start below your shoulders.
Shrugging toward your ears at the top.

form.setup: Bench upright or one notch back. Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
cues: Press straight up, stopping just short of the dumbbells touching.
Lower to shoulder height under control.
Keep your back against the pad.
watch: Arching your lower back to finish a rep.
Elbows dropping far below shoulder height.

form.setup: Bench upright, positioned so the bar comes down just in front of your face to your chin. Safety stops at chin height.
cues: Grip just outside your shoulders.
Press to nearly straight arms.
Lower to chin height, not behind your head.
watch: Bench too far back, which pulls the bar behind your neck.
Arching hard off the pad.

form.setup: Pulleys at chest height or a little above. One step forward, slight bend in the elbows that never changes.
cues: Bring your hands together in front of your chest and squeeze.
Open wide until you feel a stretch across the chest.
It's a hug, not a press: the elbow angle stays fixed.
watch: Bending the elbows more as the set gets hard.
Going so heavy that you lose the stretch.

form.setup: Lie flat, dumbbells above your chest, palms facing, a soft bend in the elbows.
cues: Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze back up along the same arc.
Keep the elbow bend fixed.
watch: Lowering past a comfortable stretch.
Turning it into a press.

form.setup: Seat height so the handles are at mid-chest. Back against the pad.
cues: Bring the handles together and squeeze for a beat.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
watch: Letting the shoulders roll forward.
Letting the stack slam.

form.setup: Parallel bars, arms locked, a slight forward lean for chest, more upright for triceps.
cues: Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Elbows track back, not out.
Press to a full lockout.
watch: Dropping so low that the front of the shoulder aches.
Half reps.

form.setup: Flat bench under the Smith, bar over your lower chest. Grip about shoulder width.
cues: Elbows tucked close to your sides.
Lower to the lower chest.
Press up by straightening the elbows hard.
watch: Grip so narrow that your wrists bend.
Elbows flaring out.

form.setup: Hands on the edge of a bench behind you, legs out in front, knees bent to make it easier.
cues: Lower until your elbows reach about 90°.
Keep your back close to the bench.
Press up to straight arms.
watch: Going deeper than 90°, which strains the shoulders.
Shrugging up toward your ears.

form.setup: Stand tall with a slight forward lean, dumbbells at your sides, a soft bend in the elbows.
cues: Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
Stop at shoulder height; higher works the traps.
Lower on a slow two count.
watch: Swinging from the hips to get the weight up.
Going heavy: a strict 10 lb beats a swung 20.

form.setup: Pulley at the lowest setting. Stand side-on to it and hold the handle in the far hand.
cues: Lead with the elbow, just like the dumbbell version.
Stop at shoulder height.
Control the way down: the cable keeps tension the whole time.
watch: Twisting your torso to help the arm up.
Standing so close that the range gets short.

form.setup: Seat height so the pivot lines up with your shoulders. Pads on the outside of your upper arms.
cues: Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause for a beat at the top.
Lower slowly.
watch: Shrugging the weight up.
Bouncing out of the bottom.

form.setup: Rope or straight bar on a high pulley. Elbows pinned to your sides, slight forward lean.
cues: Only your forearms move.
Lock the elbows fully at the bottom and squeeze.
Control the way up; don't let the stack slam.
watch: Elbows drifting forward, turning it into a chest press.
Using body weight to push the bar down.

form.setup: Rope on a low or mid pulley. Face away, rope behind your head, one foot forward.
cues: Elbows point forward and stay put.
Straighten your arms fully overhead.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in the back of the arm.
watch: Elbows flaring wide.
Arching your lower back.

form.setup: Lie flat, dumbbells above your shoulders, palms facing each other.
cues: Bend only at the elbows, lowering beside your head.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten fully and squeeze.
watch: Upper arms swinging back and forth.
Going heavy enough to make the elbows ache.

form.setup: Face away from the anchor, handles at forehead height, body leaning forward in a straight line.
cues: Bend at the elbows to bring your head between the handles.
Push back to straight arms.
Step your feet back to make it harder.
watch: Hips sagging.
Elbows flaring out.

form.setup: Thigh pad snug on your legs. Grip a little wider than your shoulders.
cues: Start each rep by pulling your shoulder blades down.
Drive your elbows down toward your back pockets.
Let your arms straighten fully at the top.
watch: Leaning far back to use body weight.
Shrugging at the top of each rep.

form.setup: Overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders. Start from a dead hang.
cues: Pull your shoulder blades down first, then drive your elbows to your ribs.
Chin over the bar, chest toward it.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
watch: Kipping or swinging.
Stopping halfway down.

form.setup: Loop a band over the bar and put one foot or knee in it. Thicker band, more help.
cues: Same as a pull-up: shoulder blades down first.
Chin over the bar.
Lower slowly; the band helps least at the bottom.
watch: Bouncing out of the bottom using the band.
Using a band so strong the reps are easy.

form.setup: High pulley, D-handle. Half-kneel facing the pulley.
cues: Pull your elbow down to your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Reach up fully between reps.
watch: Twisting your torso to finish the rep.
Short reps at the top.

form.setup: Low pulley, V-handle or rope. Sit tall on the bench or floor with your feet braced and knees soft.
cues: Pull the handle to your lower ribs, elbows sliding past your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second.
Let your arms straighten fully and your shoulders reach forward a little.
watch: Rocking your torso back and forth.
Shrugging toward your ears.

form.setup: Chest against the pad, handles at mid-torso height.
cues: Drive your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Let your arms extend fully between reps.
Keep your chest on the pad.
watch: Yanking with your lower back.
Shrugging instead of rowing.

form.setup: Bench at about 30°. Lie chest-down on it with the dumbbells hanging straight below you.
cues: Row your elbows up and back, like your hands are hooks.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top for a beat.
Let the dumbbells hang to a full stretch.
watch: Lifting your chest off the pad.
Curling the weight with your biceps.

form.setup: Same as the chest-supported row, palms facing your feet.
cues: Row with your elbows out at about 45° to hit the upper back and rear delts.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Full stretch at the bottom.
watch: Elbows tucking in, which shifts the work to the lats.
Heaving off the pad.

form.setup: One knee and hand on the bench, back flat, dumbbell hanging below your shoulder.
cues: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip.
Keep your shoulders square to the floor.
Lower to a full stretch.
watch: Twisting to heave the weight up.
Rounding your back.

form.setup: Hinge forward until your torso is about 45°, back flat, bar hanging at your knees.
cues: Pull the bar to your belly button.
Keep your back angle fixed.
Lower under control.
watch: Standing up more each rep to cheat the weight.
Rounding your lower back.

form.setup: Face the anchor, lean back with straight arms, body in one line. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
cues: Pull your chest to the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
watch: Hips sagging.
Shrugging toward your ears.

form.setup: Lock the Smith bar at about hip height. Hang underneath it, body straight, heels on the floor.
cues: Pull your chest to the bar.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Lower to straight arms.
watch: Hips sagging toward the floor.
Half reps.

form.setup: Rope at about face height. Step back until the weight lifts before you pull.
cues: Pull toward your forehead, hands finishing beside your ears.
Keep your elbows high and wide.
Light weight, slow reps: feel the back of the shoulders.
watch: Going heavy and turning it into a row.
Elbows dropping below your shoulders.

form.setup: Pulleys at shoulder height. Cross the cables: left hand holds the right cable, right hand the left.
cues: Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Pause when your arms are in line with your body.
watch: Squeezing the shoulder blades instead of moving the arms.
Too much weight, which shrinks the range.

form.setup: Lie chest-down on a bench at about 30°, light dumbbells hanging below you.
cues: Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with the elbows.
Pause at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
watch: Swinging the weight.
Shrugging up toward your ears.

form.setup: Hold a band in front of your chest, arms straight, hands shoulder width apart.
cues: Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.
watch: Bending your elbows to make it easier.
Arching your lower back.

form.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, elbows by your ribs.
cues: Curl without letting your elbows move forward.
Squeeze at the top for a beat.
Lower on a slow three count.
watch: Swinging your hips and back.
Half reps that never straighten the arm.

form.setup: Bench at 45–60°. Sit back with your arms hanging straight down behind your torso.
cues: Curl without letting your upper arm drift forward.
Squeeze at the top.
Feel the stretch at the bottom: that's why this one is here.
watch: Raising your elbows to shorten the range.
Going so heavy that you shrug.

form.setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other, and they stay that way.
cues: Curl straight up with your elbows pinned.
Pause at the top.
Control the way down.
watch: Turning it into a normal curl by rotating the wrist.
Rushing the reps.

form.setup: Straight or EZ bar on the low pulley. Stand close, elbows at your sides.
cues: Curl the bar to your shoulders without moving your elbows.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly; the cable keeps tension the whole way.
watch: Leaning back to start the rep.
Letting the elbows drift forward.

form.setup: Stand tall, bar at your thighs, shoulder-width grip, elbows at your sides.
cues: Curl to your shoulders without your elbows moving forward.
Squeeze at the top for a beat.
Lower on a slow three count.
watch: Swinging your hips and back.
Half reps.

form.setup: Bar on your upper back, hands close enough to keep your elbows under it. Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out. Brace before you unrack.
cues: Big breath into your belly and brace.
Sit down between your knees, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive the floor away through your whole foot.
watch: Knees caving in on the way up.
Heels lifting off the floor.

form.setup: Bar on your upper back. Feet slightly in front of the bar, shoulder width apart. Safety stops just below your lowest squat.
cues: Brace, unhook with a twist, then sit straight down.
Knees track over your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot.
watch: Feet too far forward, which puts the load on your lower back.
Heels lifting at the bottom.

form.setup: Shoulders and back against the pads, feet shoulder width, mid-platform.
cues: Lower until your knees are near 90°.
Drive through your whole foot.
Don't lock your knees hard at the top.
watch: Feet too high or low on the platform.
Going so deep that your lower back lifts off the pad.

form.setup: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, elbows pointing down.
cues: Sit down between your knees; elbows brush the inside of your knees.
Keep your chest tall.
Drive up through your whole foot.
watch: Heels lifting.
Going so heavy that your torso folds forward.

form.setup: Feet shoulder width, mid-platform. Back and hips flat against the pad.
cues: Lower until your knees are near 90°, before your hips lift.
Drive through your whole foot.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
watch: Going so deep that your lower back rounds off the pad.
Loading it up and doing short reps.

form.setup: Feet high on the platform, a little wider than your hips, toes slightly out. Back and hips flat against the pad.
cues: Lower until your hips are deeply bent, before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heels.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
watch: Heels lifting off the platform.
Your lower back rounding off the pad at the bottom.

form.setup: One foot in the middle of the platform, the other resting on the floor or the frame. Back and hips flat against the pad.
cues: Lower until your knee is near 90°.
Drive through your whole foot.
Finish all the reps on one leg, then switch.
watch: Your hips twisting or lifting off the seat.
The knee caving in.

form.setup: Rear foot on a bench, front foot far enough forward that your shin stays nearly vertical. Dumbbells at your sides.
cues: Drop straight down; your back knee heads for the floor.
Keep your front heel down and drive through it.
Lean your torso slightly forward to bring in the glutes.
watch: Front foot too close to the bench.
Pushing off the back foot.

form.setup: Dumbbells at your sides. Take a long step; the count is per leg.
cues: Lower until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Drive up through your front heel.
Torso tall, eyes forward.
watch: Short steps that push the front knee far past the toes.
Leaning forward and rounding your back.

form.setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides. Lunges in place, stepping back.
cues: Step back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep most of your weight on the front foot.
Drive back up through the front heel.
watch: Front knee caving in.
Pushing off the back foot.

form.setup: Stand facing a bench, one whole foot on it, dumbbells at your sides.
cues: Drive up through the top foot only.
Stand fully tall on the bench.
Lower slowly with the same leg.
watch: Pushing off the bottom foot.
Knee caving in.

form.setup: Bar on your upper back, one foot forward and one back in a long split stance.
cues: Drop straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front heel.
Keep your torso tall.
watch: A stance so short your front heel lifts.
Pushing off the back foot.

form.setup: Bar at your hips, double overhand grip, knees soft and staying that way.
cues: Push your hips straight back; the bar slides down your thighs.
Stop when your hamstrings pull hard, usually around mid-shin.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
watch: Rounding your lower back to reach lower.
Bending your knees and turning it into a squat.

form.setup: Unhook the bar at hip height. Stand close, feet hip width, so the bar runs down the front of your thighs.
cues: Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs.
Stop when your hamstrings pull hard.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
watch: Standing too far back: the fixed bar path then pulls you forward.
Rounding your lower back.

form.setup: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
cues: Push your hips back, dumbbells sliding down your legs.
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
watch: Dumbbells drifting away from your legs.
Rounding your back.

form.setup: Rope on the low pulley. Face away, rope between your legs, walk out two steps.
cues: Push your hips back, letting the rope pull between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Arms are just hooks.
watch: Squatting instead of hinging.
Leaning back at the top.

form.setup: Upper back against the side of a bench, bar over your hip crease with a pad. Feet flat, about hip width, shins vertical at the top.
cues: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down.
Drive through your heels until your hips are level with your knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard for a second at the top.
watch: Arching your lower back to get the hips higher.
Feet so far out that your hamstrings take over.

form.setup: Bench across the Smith machine, upper back against it, bar over your hip crease with a pad. Feet flat, shins vertical at the top.
cues: Unhook at the top, then lower your hips under control.
Drive through your heels until your hips are level with your knees.
Squeeze your glutes for a second before lowering.
watch: Arching your lower back at the top.
The bar sliding toward your belly.

form.setup: Upper back against the side of a bench, one dumbbell held across your hips. Feet flat, about hip width.
cues: Hold the dumbbell steady with both hands.
Drive through your heels until your hips are level with your knees.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
watch: Arching your lower back instead of moving at the hips.
Rushing the lowering half.

form.setup: Bar over your mid-foot, shins an inch away. Hinge down, grip just outside your legs, chest up, lats tight.
cues: Push the floor away; the bar and your hips rise together.
Keep the bar against your legs.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
watch: Hips shooting up first so your back does the lift.
Jerking the bar off the floor.

form.setup: Stand in the middle of the bar, grab the handles, hips down, chest up.
cues: Brace, then push the floor away.
Hips and shoulders rise together.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
watch: Rounding your back off the floor.
Letting your knees cave in.

form.setup: Set the safety stops so the bar rests at mid-shin. Stand close, feet hip width, bar over mid-foot.
cues: Hinge down, grip outside your legs, chest up.
Push the floor away; keep the bar touching your legs.
Stand tall, then lower back to the stops with control.
watch: Standing too far from the bar: the fixed path pulls you onto your toes.
Rounding your lower back.

form.setup: Knee lined up with the machine's pivot. Ankle pad just above your heels, thigh pad snug.
cues: Curl all the way in and pause for a second.
Lower slowly, about three seconds.
Let your legs straighten fully between reps.
watch: Lifting your hips to cheat the weight.
Half reps at the top.

form.setup: Lie on your back, heels in the foot cradles, straps about a foot off the floor. Lift your hips.
cues: Keep your hips up the whole time.
Pull your heels toward your glutes.
Extend slowly.
watch: Hips dropping as you tire.
Rushing the way out.

form.setup: Knee lined up with the pivot, ankle pad just above your ankles, back against the seat.
cues: Extend fully and squeeze your quads hard for a second.
Lower under control.
Toes pointed slightly up.
watch: Kicking the weight up with momentum.
Lifting your hips off the seat.

form.setup: Balls of your feet on the edge, heels free.
cues: Lower all the way into a stretch and pause.
Rise all the way onto your big toe and pause.
No bouncing: the pauses are the exercise.
watch: Rapid half reps.
Bending your knees to help.

name: Calf press on the leg press

form.setup: Balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, legs straight but not locked.
cues: Let your heels sink into a deep stretch.
Press up onto your toes and pause.
Slow and full range.
watch: Bending your knees, which turns it into a leg press.
Feet slipping off the edge: start light.

form.setup: Bar on your upper back, balls of your feet on a plate or step so your heels can drop.
cues: Lower your heels into a full stretch and pause.
Rise onto your big toes and pause.
Knees straight but soft.
watch: Bouncing.
Rolling onto the outside of your feet.

form.setup: Ball of one foot on a step or plate, a dumbbell in the same-side hand, the other hand holding on for balance.
cues: Full stretch at the bottom.
Rise all the way up and pause.
Slow reps.
watch: Bouncing.
Short range.

form.setup: Kneel facing a high pulley, rope held beside your head, hips fixed in place.
cues: Round your spine, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Your hips don't move; only your trunk folds.
Uncurl slowly and feel your abs stretch.
watch: Pulling with your arms.
Sitting back onto your heels instead of crunching.

form.setup: Hang from the bar with straight arms, shoulders slightly engaged.
cues: Curl your knees up toward your chest, tilting your pelvis.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
watch: Swinging for momentum.
Only lifting your thighs without curling the pelvis.

form.setup: Dead hang from the bar, legs straight together.
cues: Raise your legs to at least hip height, curling your pelvis up.
Control the way down.
Stay still between reps.
watch: Swinging.
Arching your lower back at the bottom.

form.setup: Forearm plank with your feet in the foot cradles, straps about a foot off the floor.
cues: Push your body back by moving at the shoulders.
Keep your lower back flat; stop before it sags.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
watch: Hips sagging.
Piking your hips up.

form.setup: Kneel on a pad, wheel under your shoulders, hips slightly tucked.
cues: Roll out while keeping your lower back flat.
Pull back with your abs, not your arms.
A shorter clean rep beats a long sagging one.
watch: Hips sagging and your lower back arching.
Piking your hips up on the way back.

form.setup: Forearms under your shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and brace like someone is about to poke your belly.
Breathe slowly.
Stop when your hips start to drop.
watch: Hips sagging.
Holding your breath.

form.setup: Pulley high, handle in both hands, stand side-on with feet wide.
cues: Rotate through your trunk to pull the handle down and across.
Pivot your back foot.
Control the return.
watch: Pulling only with your arms.
Twisting at the lower back instead of the hips and trunk.

form.setup: Pulley at chest height. Stand side-on, handle held at your chest with both hands.
cues: Press the handle straight out and hold for two seconds.
Don't let the cable rotate you.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.
watch: Leaning away from the cable.
Holding your breath.

form.setup: Kettlebell a foot in front of you, feet a little wider than shoulders. Hinge and grab it.
cues: Hike it back between your legs like a football snap.
Snap your hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall and hinge again; arms stay relaxed.
watch: Squatting the swing instead of hinging.
Lifting with your arms.

form.setup: Ball overhead in both hands, feet shoulder width.
cues: Slam it down hard in front of your feet.
Hinge to pick it up with a flat back.
Breathe out on every slam.
watch: Rounding your back to pick it up.
Standing too close, so the ball bounces into you.

form.setup: One rope end in each hand, knees bent, hips back, chest up.
cues: Fast, alternating arm waves that travel to the anchor.
Stay low in your athletic stance.
Breathe steadily.
watch: Standing upright and using only your arms.
Shrugging.

form.setup: A heavy dumbbell in each hand, standing tall.
cues: Walk with short, quick steps.
Shoulders down and back, chest up.
Don't let the weights swing.
watch: Leaning to one side.
Shrugging.

form.setup: Hug the sandbag high against your chest.
cues: Walk tall with short steps.
Brace your abs.
Breathe behind the brace.
watch: Leaning back.
Letting the bag slide down to your belly.

form.setup: Feet strapped across the balls of your feet. Sit tall, arms straight.
cues: Legs, then body, then arms on the way back.
Arms, then body, then legs on the way forward.
Most of the power comes from your legs.
watch: Pulling with your arms first.
Hunching your back at the catch.

form.setup: Stand facing the machine, handles overhead, feet hip width.
cues: Drive the handles down by hinging your hips and crunching slightly.
Finish with your hands past your hips.
Let the handles rise as you stand tall.
watch: Pulling only with your arms.
Squatting deep on every stroke.

form.setup: Hold the rails lightly for balance only.
cues: Step through your whole foot.
Stand tall.
Pick a speed you can hold with steady breathing.
watch: Leaning on the rails, which takes away most of the work.
Bouncing on your toes.

form.setup: Seat height so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
cues: Smooth circles, not stomps.
Relax your shoulders.
Hard intervals: add resistance before cadence.
watch: Seat too low, which loads the knees.
Rocking your hips side to side.

form.setup: Feet flat on the pedals, hands on the moving handles.
cues: Push and pull with your arms as well as your legs.
Stand tall.
Keep a pace you could talk at for easy sessions.
watch: Leaning on the handles.
Lifting your heels off the pedals.

form.setup: Incline 8–12%, a brisk walking pace.
cues: Swing your arms naturally.
Stand tall.
Hands off the rails.
watch: Holding the rails and leaning back.
An incline so steep you can't keep a steady pace.
